summary.text: Bill O'Brien is a Democratic state representative from District 54 who took office in 2013 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as math teacher.

paragraphs.text: O'Brien earned a B.S. in mathematics from Rhode Island College, and his professional experience includes working as a math teacher at Hope High School in Providence, according to Ballotpedia.
